question: On 1st September 2023, who was appointed as Chairman and CEO of Railway Board?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaya Verma Sinha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jaya Verma Sinha** was appointed as the Chairman and CEO of the Railway Board on 1st September 2023.
 
• She is the first woman to hold this position in the history of Indian Railways.
